level_one.title: Free Drinks
level_one.description: When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_four.title: Surging Winds
level_four.description: If Blinding Wind targets 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is instantly reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Good Stuff
level_seven.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

level_ten.title: Jug of 1,000 Cups
level_ten.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Hindering Winds
level_thirteen.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Two For One
level_sixteen.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
level_twenty.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

level_one.title: Covert Ops
level_one.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

level_four.title: Rapid Projection
level_four.description: Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.

level_seven.title: One in the Chamber
level_seven.description: After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.

level_ten.title: Precision Strike
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

level_thirteen.title: Double Tap
level_thirteen.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Explosive Round
level_sixteen.description: Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.

level_twenty.title: Precision Barrage
level_twenty.description: Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_one.title: Puncturing Arrow
level_one.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1.  Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

level_four.title: Repeating Arrow
level_four.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

level_seven.title: Monster Hunter
level_seven.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Strafe
level_ten.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Gloom
level_thirteen.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_twenty.title: Acrobat
level_twenty.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Vault. Drop 3 Caltrops while Vaulting that deal 60 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 40% for 1 second.

level_one.title: Soul Shield
level_one.description: Activate to gain 25 plus 50% of Diablo's current Souls as Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Every time Diablo damages an enemy Hero, reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

level_four.title: Souls to the Flame
level_four.description: Fire Stomp grants 1 Soul every 3 times it damages an enemy Hero, and heals for an additional 1.3% of its damage dealt per Soul.

level_seven.title: Diabolical Momentum
level_seven.description: When Diablo's Basic Attacks damage enemies, reduce the cooldown of Shadow Charge and Overpower by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Apocalypse
level_ten.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Devastating Charge
level_thirteen.description: Increase Shadow Charge's terrain collision damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit an enemy Hero against terrain 5 times.  Reward: Hitting enemy Heroes against terrain reduces their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Debilitating Flames
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Fire Stomp are Slowed by 6% for 4 seconds, up to 60%. Heroes Slowed by 24% or more by Debilitating Flames deal 50% less damage.

level_twenty.title: Hellgate
level_twenty.description: Teleport and place a demonic rune at target location. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.75 seconds.

level_one.title: Journeyman Cooking
level_one.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

level_four.title: Aggro Range
level_four.description: Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.

level_seven.title: Dense Blasting Powder
level_seven.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.  Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

level_ten.title: Shockwave
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Pummel
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.  Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Kablooie!
level_sixteen.description: Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%.  Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

level_twenty.title: No Control
level_twenty.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

level_one.title: Shifting Meteor
level_one.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.  Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.  Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

level_four.title: Fire Ward
level_four.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_seven.title: Molten Power
level_seven.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

level_ten.title: Sulfuras Smash
level_ten.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.  Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.  Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

level_thirteen.title: Cauterize Wounds
level_thirteen.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Meteor Bomb
level_sixteen.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

level_twenty.title: Submerge
level_twenty.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600 (+4% per level) Health over 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Fingers of Frost
level_one.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to increase Jaina's Mana regeneration by 0.1 per second, up to 2 per second.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, the damage bonus from Frostbite is increased by 10%.

level_four.title: Arcane Intellect
level_four.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

level_seven.title: Ice Floes
level_seven.description: Increase the width of Cone of Cold by 100% and cause each Hero hit to reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, doubled against chilled Heroes, up to a maximum of 8 seconds per use.

level_ten.title: Ring of Frost
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

level_thirteen.title: Icy Veins
level_thirteen.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Numbing Blast
level_sixteen.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 0.75 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cold Snap
level_twenty.description: The center area of Ring of Frost deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies after the outer ring expires. Each enemy Hero hit reduces its cooldown by 15 seconds.

level_one.title: Lion's Maw
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Taunt
level_four.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

level_seven.title: Lionheart
level_seven.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

level_ten.title: Shield Wall
level_ten.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

level_thirteen.title: Juggernaut
level_thirteen.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Stormwind
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Demoralizing Shout
level_twenty.description: Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.  Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

level_one.title: Low Blow
level_one.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level_four.title: Vigorous Reuptake
level_four.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

level_seven.title: Growing Infestation
level_seven.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Flailing Swipe
level_ten.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level_thirteen.title: It Hungers
level_thirteen.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_sixteen.title: Pox Populi
level_sixteen.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Top Off
level_twenty.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

level_one.title: Vengeful Roots
level_one.description: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and loses Health over 11 seconds.  Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

level_four.title: Celestial Alignment
level_four.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

level_seven.title: Tenacious Roots
level_seven.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

level_ten.title: Twilight Dream
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Hindering Moonfire
level_thirteen.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Nature's Balance
level_sixteen.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Lunar Shower
level_twenty.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.
